# Aomi

> Aomi is the execution harness for onchain AI. Plain-language instructions become real transactions — EVM and Solana behind one interface — through one pipeline: build, simulate, sign, broadcast. Non-custodial: the agent proposes, the user's own key signs. Aomi is also a hosted platform ("Vercel for crypto agents"): you compose your APIs, skills, and prompt as a plugin, the runtime loads it dynamically, and your users reach the agent via widget, Telegram, or Discord.

## Use Aomi
- [Introduction](https://aomi.dev/docs/index): what Aomi is, demo clips, and the architecture.
- [Portal](https://aomi.dev/docs/trade/portal): the hosted chat at chat.aomi.dev — connect a wallet and trade by chat.
- [Agents with MCP](https://aomi.dev/docs/guides/mcp): connect Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP client to the Aomi server.
- [Client CLI](https://aomi.dev/docs/reference/cli): install the aomi command, chat, simulate, and sign from the terminal — every command, flag, and environment variable.

## Trade on Aomi
- [Overview](https://aomi.dev/docs/trade/index): how Aomi executes on-chain trades.
- [How execution works](https://aomi.dev/docs/trade/execution): the simulate-before-sign trade flow.

## Build on Aomi
- [Overview](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/index): why plugins exist, what an App is, and the path to ship one.
- [Quickstart](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/quickstart): zero to a deployed App.
- [Plugin anatomy](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/plugins/anatomy): the crate layout, aomi.toml, preamble, and tools.
- [Rust SDK](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/plugins/sdk): the DynAomiTool trait and the dyn_aomi_app! macro.
- [Custom tools](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/plugins/custom-tools): add your own tools with DynAomiTool.
- [Evals and testing](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/plugins/evals): test a plugin before it ships.
- [aomi-run](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/toolchain/aomi-run): the local dev runtime — chat with your plugin before shipping.
- [aomi-build](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/toolchain/aomi-build): connect, deploy, and activate from the terminal.
- [The Developer Platform](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/platform): create, deploy, and operate Apps from the browser at build.aomi.dev.
- [Put your App on Telegram](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/telegram-bot): turn a deployed App into a hosted Telegram bot.
- [Common errors](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/common-errors): the errors a builder hits and the fixes.
